observations: Formal composer and queued references display literal original names with no extra @. Object and task @ search remains functional.
Computed background and border match the preview in both themes. Formal text equals resolved theme --ink; queue uses the same Ink, background and border.
320px screenshots inspected independently. Light formal text rgb(32,32,32), preview rgb(112,112,112); dark formal rgb(243,243,243), preview rgb(170,170,170).

Each formal DOM occurrence gets a local host key, survives serialization as its own order entry, and has a targeted removal callback. Persistence contains kind/id/textOffset, with no new occurrence identity field.

Repeated same-source object and task entries at equal or different UTF-16 offsets preserve array order through API, CLI, restart, browser reload, Send, queued edit/reopen/cancel, and history after original object deletion.

Button, Backspace, Delete, cross-atom range deletion and native replacement remove only selected occurrences. Unicode and IME retain offsets; source IDs remain present until the final occurrence is removed.
Each explicit object selection can insert the same source again. SSE and theme rerenders retain the consumed preview without creating further occurrences.
A delayed first HTTP draft save followed by deletion of one occurrence, new Unicode text and direct Send submits the latest full order.
objectIds/taskIds and referenceContent object/asset/task source lists remain unique. Same raw ID in object and task kinds is treated as two distinct sources.

checks: Source-list uniqueness, complete occurrence coverage, at most 2000 order entries, integer in-range UTF-16 positions and whole Unicode boundaries remain enforced.
Source membership and foreign-task session permissions remain enforced independently of occurrence count. Repeated forbidden task sources return task_reference_scope and retain the whole draft.
Stale draft revision returns draft_revision_conflict and retains the whole draft. Save and Send retain existing short-transaction and revision checks.
Injected local hostKey/occurrenceId metadata is stripped from saved references and never appears in the submitted snapshot.
Existing live service, user data, OS clipboard, existing browser windows, Keychain, shared dist and Git index were untouched.

initialSandboxAttempt.followup: Same owned temporary fixtures ran successfully in the permitted environment.

validation.freshBrowserProfiles: Owned temporary project runtime/browser-profile; headless Chrome, OS renderer sandbox enabled.
validation.sourceCurrency: After test completion, dedicated reference sources/tests/service/useBoard/task-message were byte-compared with the repository and matched. App requestTitle/task-inline-reference/selectObjects/ChatboxEditor and reference CSS lines matched the tested candidate.

boundaries: This report independently accepts requirements 3 and 4 only. Requirements 1, 2 and 5 through 8 remain under their separate execution and review scopes.

The complete default suite and CEF/media matrix were not rerun in this reference review. The execution report intermediate default failures retain their original history and are not counted as passes here.
Review created evidence files only in the repository; production source and main documentation were read only. Git remains uncommitted for the root agent.
